description: This file defines the KamonHistogram class, an implementation of a Histogram interface, utilizing the Kamon monitoring library to record and retrieve histogram data with tagging support.

classes.name: KamonHistogram
classes.description: An immutable class implementing Histogram, providing methods to record values, manage tags, reset, and retrieve recorded data using Kamon metrics.

methods.name: newHistogram
methods.description: Creates a new KamonHistogram instance with the specified name and empty tags.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Returns a new Histogram instance with an added tag key-value pair.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns a new Histogram instance with multiple tags added or replaced.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns all tags associated with the histogram.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Attempts to reset the histogram's snapshot, returning true if successful.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a value into the histogram.

methods.name: getRecordedValues
methods.description: Returns all recorded bucket values as an array.

methods.name: addBucketValuesToList
methods.description: Helper method to add bucket values to a list based on bucket frequency.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the histogram, optionally resetting it.

methods.name: getKamonInternalHistogram
methods.description: Retrieves the Kamon histogram object with current tags.
